draft.subject: Re: Inviting a teammate
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for the update -- good to hear getting everyone set up is on the list this week. Your ticket about inviting a teammate is still open with us, and here's the short answer: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

On the work itself, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Nadia
